subject: pe
title: Anaerobic Glycolysis
welcome_lead: 30 seconds to 2 minutes — glucose without oxygen, lactate as a byproduct.
meta_desc: A-Level PE adventure on anaerobic glycolysis and lactate production.
final_note: Lactate is not the villain — H⁺ is. Distinguish the chemistry.

concepts.def: Glucose → 2 pyruvate; 10-step cytosolic pathway producing 2 ATP net.
Pyruvate accepting H from NADH when O₂ insufficient.
Dominant for 30 s to 2 min of intense effort.
Liver converts lactate back to glucose; uses 6 ATP per glucose.
Source of acidic fatigue, not lactate itself.

walkthroughs.body_html: Net glycolysis yields 2 ATP per glucose — fast but inefficient compared to aerobic.
Lactate is shuttled to oxidative fibres or the liver (Cori cycle), not simply 'waste'.
Falling pH (down to ~6.8) inhibits PFK and contraction. Sodium bicarbonate loading buffers this.
